Rockshelter Capital Management Holding in T (TMUS) Has Boosted by $3.01 Million as Market Value Declined; Enlink Midstream (ENLC) Valuation Declined While Kayne Anderson Capital Advisors LP Has Upped Its Position
May 25, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Rockshelter Capital Management Llc increased its stake in T (TMUS) by 23.46% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rockshelter Capital Management Llc bought 47,850 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.16% with the market. The institutional investor held 251,813 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.99M, up from 203,963 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rockshelter Capital Management Llc who had been investing in T for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $48.25B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.07% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $56.98. About 2.35 million shares traded. T-Mobile US, Inc. (NYSE:TMUS) has declined 6.04% since May 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.59% the S&P500.
Kayne Anderson Capital Advisors Lp increased its stake in Enlink Midstream Llc (ENLC) by 12.74% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kayne Anderson Capital Advisors Lp bought 29,400 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.15% with the market. The hedge fund held 260,100 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.58M, up from 230,700 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kayne Anderson Capital Advisors Lp who had been investing in Enlink Midstream Llc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.98 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.20% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $16.45. About 223,485 shares traded. EnLink Midstream, LLC (NYSE:ENLC) has declined 21.83% since May 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.38% the S&P500.
